description: Venues in Boston, Denver, San Francisco, Nashville or New York that have upcoming shows, with show_count and public facts (address, capacity, bag_policy, MBTA in Boston). Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total. Use get_venue or search_shows with venue= for one room and its upcoming shows.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville and the rest of Greater Boston, Massachusetts), denver (Denver, Boulder and the Colorado Front Range), sanfrancisco (San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley and the rest of the Bay Area), nashville (Nashville, Franklin, Murfreesboro and the rest of Middle Tennessee) or newyork (the five boroughs of New York City and the big rooms just outside them). Set denver for anything in Colorado, sanfrancisco for anything in the Bay Area, nashville for anything in Middle Tennessee and newyork for anything in New York City.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.
